procedural_matters: SWE 117 was represented by Maja HANSSON-MILD.
GBR 38 was represented by Jessica JOBSON.
Daniel Birgmark (coach of SWE 117) and Tom Saunt (coach of GBR 38) attended the hearing as observers.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were approximately 15 knots of wind and flat water.
During the second upwind, SWE 117 was sailing close-hauled on starboard tack and GBR 38 was sailing close-hauled on port tack, both on converging courses.
When the boats were about one boat length apart, SWE 117 bore away and passed less than 1 meter astern of GBR 38.
conclusions: GBR 38 on port tack failed to keep clear of SWE 117 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
decision: GBR 38 is disqualified in race Q1.
